Plus, we’re HIPAA compliant and secure, protecting valuable information and your law firm’s reputation.

Our intake specialists are trained to sign all qualified leads immediately once the intake process is complete. items.q: How can Alert improve my business?
items.a: By partnering with Alert, you will see significant cost savings and increased profits. We are proud to provide superior call center services, saving you time and money that might otherwise be spent managing your staff. Our objective is to provide you with a specialized and professional call center service, allowing you to concentrate on your core business objectives. Our agents are highly qualified to handle the specific needs of your organization and are steadfastly focused on maintaining and growing your business.

items.q: How do I know my leads are safe with Alert?
items.a: Alert has been in business since 1965, and has over 3,000 attorney clients across the country. We know that every lead that comes into your firm is valuable. We would never risk our reputation for honesty by distributing leads to other clients. This is why Alert offers the most transparent and informative marketing and call reports available in the industry. We even suggest that you cross-reference our reports with those from your phone provider(s). If there is a discrepancy, there is a problem! At Alert you won’t find those problems. Your leads are safe with us.

items.q: What systems do you have in place to ensure excellent agent performance?
items.a: We monitor agent calls and score call-handling skills such as courtesy, response time, accuracy and overall service to our clients. We review the results and use them to improve performance, recognize exceptional execution, and uncover opportunities to improve our training.

items.q: What type of training do agents receive?
items.a: Our receptionists are the primary point-of-contact for our customers. Alert requires all of our agents to complete a comprehensive training program, ensuring a consistent, professional, and exceptional service experience for both you and your clients. Prior to handling legal answering service accounts, our receptionists must complete our proprietary legal-receptionist training module. Upon completion, they receive the Alert Certification. To maintain their certification, they must meet specific performance levels on an ongoing basis. In addition, our agents receive training on ALL new accounts prior to taking calls.

items.a: No. We believe this is a conflict of interest. If your call center is owned by a law firm or a marketing/advertising company, we suggest you contact us as soon as possible.

items.q: Who do I contact if I have a problem?

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: It typically takes 7-10 business days to get a new account started. At Alert we customize everything for our clients. Once we gather the information on how you would like your calls to be handled, we then train all of our Intake Specialists to answer your calls. If you require an emergency start, we can accommodate you.

items.a: Yes! Alert works with law firms across the country. All you need to do is call-forward your number to us and we will handle the rest, 24/7/365.
